description:
Please update the semantic version and changelog for a Kubernetes operator manifest as follows: 1. In the directory /home/user/operator, there is a file named VERSION whose initial contents are 1.2.3. Bump the patch version so the new version should be 1.2.4. The VERSION file must only contain the semantic version string, nothing else. 2. Update the CHANGELOG.md file in /home/user/operator. At the very top, add a new changelog entry in the following markdown format: 
## [1.2.4] - 2023-08-18

* Bumped patch version for bugfix
Make sure the new entry is inserted above all existing entries, and that the section header and bullet point formatting exactly match the above. When finished, create a log file at /home/user/operator/version_bump.log containing a single line: 
VERSION bumped to 1.2.4 and changelog updated.
This log file will be used for verification, so ensure it is written exactly as specified.
